svg.title: Analog / RF + Josephson + ADI module — 4K cryogenic SoC
svg.desc: High-level block diagram of the full analog signal path from RF input through superconducting processing to digital conversion. Signal flow is top-to-bottom through three clearly separated domains: analog, superconducting, and digital output. Control signals enter from the right.

g.text: CPW resonator pre-filter · cryo HEMT amp
Pre-ADC buffer · impedance match to JJ stage
Tunable BPF / LPF / notch via flux bias
High-Q JJ resonators · Fano resonance suppression
Mixer · parametric amp · envelope detector · env_out
mix_en gated · pump tone from bias_ctrl
GSPS sampling · cryo-stable offset · overflow flag
